title: MASM/TASM Unified Action Configuration v1
description: JSON Schema for dosasm.jsonc and masmtasm.ASM.actions in package.json. Defines the unified action object used for assembly run/debug configuration.

bundlePath.description: Path to a built-in jsdos bundle. Format: '<built-in>/NAME.jsdos' where NAME is the bundle identifier (e.g. 'TASM', 'MASM-v6.11'). The extension resolves this to resources/NAME.jsdos.

commandString.description: A single DOS command. Supports template variables: ${file}, ${filename}, ${filefolder}, ${fileDisk}, ${fileOS}, ${fileOSname}, ${fileOSfolder}, ${actionFolder}, ${<built-in>/...} (local bundle), ${https://...} / ${http://...} (network bundle), ${seperateSpaceFolder}, ${logfile}. The '>' prefix is not a special syntax; if present it is silently stripped.

commandArray.description: Ordered list of DOS commands executed in sequence.

ignorePattern.description: Glob pattern for directories to skip when injecting the action folder into the bundle. Applied to directory names only (not file names).

unifiedAction.description: Unified action configuration object. Used both as the 'action' property in dosasm.jsonc and as each value in masmtasm.ASM.actions in package.json.

before.description: Environment setup commands executed before run/debug. Fully controls mount points in both dosasm.jsonc and package.json modes. No default auto-mounting is performed; all mount operations must be explicitly defined here.

open.description: Commands executed only when opening the emulator without running or debugging. Also used as fallback when run/debug commands are empty.

run.description: Commands to assemble, link, and execute the program. Required.

debug.description: Commands to assemble with debug info, link, and launch the debugger. Required.

copyFileAs.description: Controls whether the active editor file is copied before run/debug. undefined (absent): copy with default name (test.<ext> for jsdos, TEST.<EXT> for DOSBox). null: do not copy, rely on mount commands to make the original file accessible. string: copy to this path relative to code/ (jsdos) or ${seperateSpaceFolder}/ (DOSBox).

support.description: List of emulators that this action profile is compatible with. Used by the assembler selector to filter options. If absent, all emulators are assumed compatible.

ignore.description: Glob patterns for directories to skip when adding the action folder (dosasm.jsonc context only, jsdos mode only). Applied during recursive directory traversal.

overwrite.description: Conditional command overrides keyed by emulator. When a 'when' condition matches the active emulator, its fields are merged onto the base action (only explicitly declared fields are overridden).

overWrite.description: A conditional override entry. When 'when.emulator' matches the active emulator, the contained fields replace the corresponding fields on the base UnifiedAction.

emulator.description: The emulator to match. Supports exact match against jsdos, jsdos-x, dosbox, dosbox-x.

dosasmJsonc.title: dosasm.jsonc (project-level configuration)
dosasmJsonc.description: Project-level action configuration placed in any directory of the workspace. The extension searches upward from the target .asm file to find the nearest dosasm.jsonc.

action.description: The unified action configuration. If absent, the extension falls back to package.json defaults.

copyFileAs.description: DEPRECATED: Legacy top-level copyFileAs. Use action.copyFileAs instead. Retained for backward compatibility; if action.copyFileAs is absent, this value is used.

packageJsonActions.title: masmtasm.ASM.actions (global action profiles)
packageJsonActions.description: Map of assembler profile IDs to UnifiedAction objects. Defined in package.json under contributes.configuration.properties['masmtasm.ASM.actions']. The active profile is selected via masmtasm.ASM.assembler.

^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$.description: Action profile keyed by assembler ID (e.g. 'TASM', 'MASM-v6.11', 'TASM-com').
